description: Score an array of inline financing scenarios in one stateless call; returns ranked decisions and top offers per item — no persisted cohorts, no per-borrower HTTP loops.

credit_score.description: Optional default credit score applied to scenarios lacking one

scenarios.description: Inline scenarios to score in one stateless call (no persisted cohorts).

state.description: Optional 2-letter default state applied to scenarios lacking one

name: batch_decisions

count.description: Number of scenarios evaluated in this batch.

results.description: One result per scenario, ordered by rank rather than by the order submitted — match them back with `id`.

best_offer.description: The single best offer for this scenario, with lender, APR and rate in percent, and monthly payment in dollars.

id.description: The caller's own identifier for this scenario, used to match results back to inputs.

index.description: Zero-based position of this scenario in the submitted array.

offers.description: All ranked offers found for this scenario, each with rank, lender, APR, rate, and monthly payment.

rank.description: Ranking of this scenario against the others in the batch, 1 = strongest opportunity.

recommended_action.description: Recommended move for this scenario, e.g. 'shop_providers'.

status.description: Whether the scenario resolved: 'ok' means offers were found; other values mean no usable pricing.

scenarios_no_offer.description: How many scenarios found nothing; those results carry no pricing and should not be reported as expensive.

scenarios_with_offer.description: How many scenarios found at least one live offer.
